text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way home after a day out with
Satono
Diamond, we spot two
Umamusume hanging out
by a
convenience store.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Another Flamingo Kid?! Damn it! That's
my fifth
one!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I struck out too... Just a Pebble Worm.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's Golshi and Nakayama. I'm going
to ask
them what they're doing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I have a bad feeling about this, so I
follow after
Satono Diamond.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hello. And what might you be doing this
fine day?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Satono! We just bought a whole
heap of
"Creature Shock Choc" candy!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
We've been eating one after another,
but we just
can't manage to pull Ammo
Knight, the shelled
warrior—it's a super
rare card!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So you're taking on a new challenge?
That sounds
fun! Do you mind if I join
you?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha. You sure are nosy for someone so
prim and
proper. ...Fine. Pick whichever
one you want.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm, let's see...
Which one do you
think I should choose, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That's the one I had my eye on too!
Here
goes!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I got a...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It's... um... Don...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Don Pterano, the dinosaur mob boss!
Whoa! I
can't believe you got one!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: It's holographic too... Not bad, Satono.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Do you mean to say I found a rare one?!
In that
case, I'd like to try opening
another!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Go wild! And send them down this way
as you
do—I'm the one who's gonna be
eating all that
chocolate!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Okay! Here I go...
Alto! Stop right there!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to buy some Creature Shock
Chocs!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
But they were all sold out... I guess I
have all of
you thank for that!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Geez... Why so grumpy, El?
I tell you
what...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Let's throw down! If you win, I'll give you
this Don
Pterano card! But if you lose,
you get this Sleepy
Cicada!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I accept your challenge! That Don
Pterano will be
mine!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I hope you're ready!
It's time to...

text_block_list.name: Golshi & El
text_block_list.text: DUEL!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Uh, things have taken quite the
unexpected turn,
haven't they, Trainer?

Just leave them be. They'll tire
themselves out
eventually...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Cafe! Are you here to do some
shopping?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The cafe I usually go to is closed...
so I came
here instead...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
But on second thought... I think I'll go
someplace
else... See you later...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, it sounds like you have several
favorite
cafes you frequent. I'd very
much like to tag
along, if you don't
mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite the fierce battle unfolding in
front of her,
Satono Diamond's curiosity
leads her on yet
another adventure. She
really is pure at heart.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Taking the more arduous path! I like the
sound of
that.
Here goes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, just as Satono Diamond goes
to open
the wrapper, a strong gust of
wind blows it onto
the ground before
someone's feet.
Hm? What's this?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Sheesh. A candy wrapper? Is this a
preschool
event or something?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Perfect timing.
You want in on
this, Sirius?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
In on what? A wager using candy?
Please, how old
do you think I—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
What do we have here? A pure-hearted
maiden...
I might be interested if you
were my opponent.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Opponent? Are you talking about a
wager?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I am indeed. If the card in this chocolate
wrapper
is a "boss" creature, you win.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
But if it's a "follower" creature, you lose,
and I get
to make one request that you
can't refuse... Deal?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. How very intriguing. I absolutely
can't
afford to lose with a condition like
that. ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I accept your challenge!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Here goes!

text_block_list.name: Golshi & Nakayama
text_block_list.text: WHAAAT?!

text_block_list.name: Golshi & Nakayama
text_block_list.text:
It's a secret creature! The digital
dinosaur,
5t3g05auru5!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship and Nakayama Festa wildly
latch on to
the card the second they see
it!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Secret creature? So does that means it's
not a
boss or follower?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Tch. Oh, well. That means our little
wager is
void. I may not have beaten
you, but I did get to
see something
interesting.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Then what if we simply postpone our
competition
for now? Hehe. ♪

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Oho?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Neither of us won, so I'd love to
compete against
you again sometime!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hah! Ahahaha! You were lucky to escape
that
situation unscathed, yet you want
to jump right
back into the fire?!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...So be it. I'll wait for you at the top,
and I look
forward to the day you
ascend to my level.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. ♪ Now I have one more
destination to
strive toward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond doesn't back down
from
challenging her senior. I realize
once again just
how strong-willed she
really is.
